desc: KRISS USA's Vector Ambidextrous Folding Stock is designed for the Vector Gen II Post-2017 models. The stock is constructed of steel, aluminum, and advanced polymer composites. The KRISS Vector Ambidextrous Folding Stock secures to the upper receiver with a push button hinge that will fold to the right or left. The stock features two QD sling swivel mounts on the left and right side, as well as a sling loop towards the rear. In addition to folding, this stock is also telescopic, adjusting to three different length of pull positions.
